title: Sebastian and the Vector
author: Felix Villalobos
blurb: Sable Yarrow, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
